@factored_cube_sum_eq_gammaBatchedDescriptorResidual : ∀ {m : ℕ} (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (wv : ℕ → BabyBear)
  (enc : Fin (GateMleExt6.descriptorResiduals d wv).length ↪ Fin m → Bool) (gamma : Ext6Q),
  ∑ b, factoredGatePolynomial d wv enc gamma (cubePt b) = gammaBatchedDescriptorResidual d wv gamma
@factored_individualDegree_le_two : ∀ {m : ℕ} (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (wv : ℕ → BabyBear)
  (enc : Fin (GateMleExt6.descriptorResiduals d wv).length ↪ Fin m → Bool) (gamma : Ext6Q) (i : Fin m)
  (x : Fin m → Ext6Q),
  ∃ q,
    q.degree < ↑(2 + 1) ∧
      ∀ (t : Ext6Q), Polynomial.eval t q = factoredGatePolynomial d wv enc gamma (Function.update x i t)
@factoredRounds_terminal_of_openings : ∀ {m : ℕ} (d : ConstraintDescriptor BabyBear) (wv : ℕ → BabyBear)
  (enc : Fin (GateMleExt6.descriptorResiduals d wv).length ↪ Fin m → Bool) (gamma : Ext6Q) (r : Fin m → Ext6Q)
  (opened : TerminalOpenings d wv enc gamma r),
  scChain (gammaBatchedDescriptorResidual d wv gamma) (factoredRounds d wv enc gamma (chalOf r)) (chalOf r) m =
    opened.affineValue TerminalKind.mulA * opened.affineValue TerminalKind.mulB - opened.affineValue TerminalKind.mulC +
            opened.affineValue TerminalKind.addA +
          opened.affineValue TerminalKind.addB -
        opened.affineValue TerminalKind.addC +
      opened.affineValue TerminalKind.zero
@etaBatched_opening_identity : ∀ {t : ℕ} (eta : Ext6Q) (trace : ℕ → Ext6Q) (values constants : Fin t → Ext6Q)
  (weights : Fin t → ℕ →₀ Ext6Q),
  (∀ (j : Fin t), values j = constants j + (Finsupp.linearCombination Ext6Q trace) (weights j)) →
    ∑ j, eta ^ ↑j * (values j - constants j) = (Finsupp.linearCombination Ext6Q trace) (etaBatchedWeights eta weights)
@card_bad_eta_le : ∀ {t : ℕ} (challenges : Finset Ext6Q) (trace : ℕ → Ext6Q) (values constants : Fin t → Ext6Q)
  (weights : Fin t → ℕ →₀ Ext6Q),
  (∃ j, openingDefect trace values constants weights j ≠ 0) →
    {eta ∈ challenges | ∑ j, eta ^ ↑j * openingDefect trace values constants weights j = 0}.card ≤ t - 1
